description: Jackson / JPA framework pack: annotations resolved by the Jackson serializer or the JPA persistence provider, never by in-repo callers. A member carrying one of these annotations is framework-invoked (KEEP); a class carrying one of keepClassAnnotations is framework-managed, so its private members are REVIEW at most, never SAFE. Deduplicated against frameworks/spring.json: Spring annotations (@Transactional, @Service, ...) live only there, Jackson/JPA annotations only here. The core JPA stereotypes (Entity, Embeddable, MappedSuperclass) are also listed in src/parse-java.js FRAMEWORK_CLASS_ANNOTATIONS as a fallback; this pack is the authoritative data list and adds the wider set.
notes: Jackson reads @JsonProperty / @JsonCreator members during serialization; JPA reads @Entity fields and runs @PrePersist / @PostLoad lifecycle methods through the persistence provider. A @JsonIgnoreProperties class is deserialized by Jackson, so its members are framework-managed.
